name: video-director
description: Directs a narrated video end to end (release, tutorial, product demo, promo, explainer, or any other): writes the requirements brief, follows a format protocol or the general process, researches, scripts, captures the app or cards with callout rings on what the narration names, records it in the user's ElevenLabs voice, adds a music bed and mixes to mp4; use for "make a release video for v1.2", "a tutorial video on setting up X", "a two-minute demo of the app", "a 30-second teaser", "redo the video with callouts".
